pr_body:
fix #693

Also ensures that `stopService` will always wait for the service to actually have been created.
Otherwise, I think there might be edge cases where `stopService` is called _before_ the service has actually been _started,_ preventing proper cleanup.

issue_context.title: esbuildService: singleton initializer can be entered concurrently
comments: I think my fix can be simplified a bit more. I'll try to open a PR.

review_comments:
Until this `await`-promise is resolved, subsequent calls to `ensureService` will create additional instances.
But later on, only one of those instances will be stopped.
That's why this commit changes the code to set the variable synchronously.
